threads.body:
`opentelemetry.util.genai.types` renames public message-part classes (e.g. `Text` -> `TextPart`) but does not provide any backwards-compatible aliases. This is a hard runtime break for any downstream code importing the old names, and it conflicts with the util package’s back-compat guidance to deprecate rather than remove/rename public objects (see CodingGuidelineID: 1000003, “API backwards compatibility”).

Consider keeping the old names as deprecated aliases to the new `*Part` classes so existing imports keep working while users migrate.
